letools.label: Last Epoch Tools
notes: Data payload is plain JS assignments (window.coreDB / LEAbilities / itemDB / LESkillTrees) served under /data/versionNNN/.
The version directory name and script filenames must be rediscovered from the current pages; they are not a stable API.
No Cloudflare challenge observed on 2026-11-01 for static data files.

tunklab.label: Tunklab
notes: Next.js (Turbopack) client bundles embed literal data modules, e.g. let a={version:'1.5.2',data:{...}};e.s([...]).
No JSON API found in initial recon; data must be extracted from the referenced JS chunks without executing them.
Chunk filenames change on every deploy and must be rediscovered from the page HTML.

game.label: Local Last Epoch install
notes: Used only to fill concrete gaps after web sources; never modifies game files.
Enabled per-task after a gap is identified and the tool compatibility is verified.
